description: Schema for extracting key information from an invoice document.

invoiceNumber.description: The unique identifier for the invoice.

vendorName.description: The name of the vendor or seller issuing the invoice.

issueDate.description: The date the invoice was issued, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

dueDate.description: The date the invoice payment is due, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

lineItems.description: A list of individual items or services detailed in the invoice.

description.description: A description of the item or service.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item or service.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the item or service.

amount.description: The total amount for this line item (quantity * unit price).

subtotal.description: The sum of all line item amounts before taxes and discounts.

taxAmount.description: The total amount of tax applied to the invoice.

grandTotal.description: The final total amount of the invoice, including subtotal and tax.
